name: canonical-docs-sweep
query: update the docs with what we did
why: The settled boundary: wrap-up explicitly disclaims this as notes on its own. If it does not fire here, the two descriptions are not separable.

name: take-notes
why: The phrasing the skill is named for. No file names, no git vocabulary.

name: write-up-the-session
query: write up what we got done today
why: Session-scoped documentation with no use of the words notes or docs. Checks the trigger is not keyed on a single phrase.

name: stale-plan-file
query: tasks/plan.md is out of date, fold today's work into it
why: Names a hot file the skill governs and asks for the merge, which is step 3 of the sweep.

name: archive-finished-work
query: the shipped items are still sitting in the plan, move them into completed
why: Step 4 relocation to tasks/completed/ in the user's own words. Cold storage belongs to this skill and nowhere else.

name: hot-file-over-budget
query: todo.md has grown to 300 lines, that's a dumping ground now
why: The size gate and the reduction pass. A complaint rather than an instruction, so the softer of the true cases, but the remedy is this sweep.

name: capture-before-forgetting
query: let's get what we figured out written down before we lose it
why: Documentation intent with no file named and no session-end language. Competes with reflect, which claims durable knowledge; the object here is the written record, not memory.

name: session-closeout
why: wrap-up. Whole-session closeout runs notes as one link in a longer chain; the sweep must not claim the chain.

name: chain-naming-notes
query: notes, commit, then sync it up
why: wrap-up. The hardest false case: the word notes is right there, but three of the chain verbs named together is the closeout, not the sweep.

name: truth-reconciliation
query: reconcile what we learned this session
why: reflect. Memory promotion and stale-claim correction happen before the docs sweep and are a separate procedure with its own approval gate.

name: save-to-memory
query: remember that the daemon only listens on localhost
why: reflect. Memory writes are reflect's, and notes governs six repo paths that do not include memory.

name: orientation
query: get me up to speed on this repo
why: hi. Reading the same living docs, but read-only and at the start of a session rather than the end.

name: single-readme-edit
query: add the install one-liner I just gave you to the README
why: A plain Edit. The file is in scope for the sweep, but one dictated line is not a session reconstruction, a size gate, or a cold-storage pass.

name: in-code-documentation
query: add a docstring explaining what this function returns
why: A plain Edit in source. Notes governs six repo-root paths; comments and docstrings are not among them.

name: changelog-entry
query: add an entry to CHANGELOG.md for the release
why: A plain Edit. The skill states explicitly that a published CHANGELOG is a release artifact and out of scope, distinct from tasks/completed/.
